svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Character Record
svg.desc: One per hero, kept between games. The numbers a hero carries from one game to the next, and a line for every game they have played. Generated by tools/build-record.mjs from data/recordsheet.json, data/components.json recordSheet and data/rules.json level - do not edit. 210 x 297 mm at 8 units/mm.

g.text: One per hero, kept between games.
Rewrite these at the end of every game.
One rise at every milestone level. Add these to the card's boxes at setup, every game.
Tick one box a deed. When the ticks reach the level you are rising to, take it, clear the ladder and carry what is over.
Deeds to reach the level, and in all since level 0.
